name: MonarchEmptyState
title: EmptyState
summary: What will appear in an empty view and the action that creates it, with Monarch's type, colours and buttons.
whenToUse: When a list, a screen or a card has nothing in it: before anything was created, when filters hide everything, or when everything is done.
whenNotToUse: When the region failed to load, use MonarchErrorState. For search with no results, the system ContentUnavailableView.search is also a good fit.
api: init(_ title: String, message: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, kind: MonarchEmptyStateKind = .firstRun, size: MonarchEmptyStateSize = .md, tip: String? = nil, tipKey: String? = nil, actionTitle: String? = nil, secondaryActionTitle: String? = nil, clearFiltersLabel: String? = nil, action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, secondaryAction: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onClearFilters: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
enum MonarchEmptyStateKind { case firstRun, filtered, success }
enum MonarchEmptyStateSize { case sm, md, lg }

options.name: message
options.description: What will appear here, or what to do next.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the SF Symbol of the kind.

options.name: kind
options.description: Why the view is empty. Selects the default icon and its colour.

options.name: size
options.description: sm is a tight block, md sits in a card or list, lg fills the height and centres itself.

options.name: tip
options.description: A short hint under the buttons.

options.name: actionTitle
options.description: Title of the main button. No button without it.

options.name: secondaryActionTitle
options.description: Title of the second button. No button without it.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when the main button is activated.

options.name: secondaryAction
options.description: Runs when the second button is activated.

options.name: onClearFilters
options.description: Clears the app's filters. With the filtered kind it adds a button before the others.

options.name: tipKey
options.description: A key named in the tip, drawn as a key cap where it first appears.

states.name: first run
states.description: A tray icon in the muted text colour.

states.name: filtered
states.description: A filter icon, and a "Clear filters" button when onClearFilters is given.

states.name: success
states.description: A check mark icon in the success colour.

appearance: Centred icon, title in the default text colour and message in the muted text colour, in one centred column (as the web). The icon is muted, or the strong success colour for the success kind. The main button is the primary Monarch button, clear filters is secondary and the second action is ghost.
platformNotes: Drawn by Monarch as on the web (a 20 point glyph on a 40 point rounded tile, 8 points between title and message, 32 points above and below), not by ContentUnavailableView, which scales any icon to its own large size. Up to two actions by title and closure instead of the web's actions slot; the web children slot (extra content after the actions) is not offered. The web's line layout (one row with icon, text and actions) is not offered. Web sizes compact, inline and page are sm, md and lg here. tip is a String, so it cannot hold a keyboard-shortcut element. Android builds the same component. Several closures are optional (action, secondaryAction, onClearFilters). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is action.
accessibility: The title has the header trait.
The icon is hidden from VoiceOver; the title and message carry the meaning.
Buttons are standard buttons with the Monarch style and touch targets of at least 44 points.
Title, message, icon and buttons scale with Dynamic Type; text wraps.
edgeCases: actionTitle without action, or action without actionTitle, shows no button.
onClearFilters is ignored unless kind is filtered.
With size lg the state takes all the height it is offered; put it in a container with a bounded height, not directly in a ScrollView.

examples.title: First run
examples.template:
MonarchEmptyState(
    {{title}},
    message: {{description}},
    systemImage: "plus",
    tip: {{tip}},
    tipKey: {{tipKey}},
    actionTitle: {{primaryAction}},
    secondaryActionTitle: {{secondaryAction}},
    action: {},
    secondaryAction: {}
)
examples.code:
MonarchEmptyState(
    "No tickets yet",
    message: "New tickets from your inbox and portal appear here.",
    systemImage: "plus",
    tip: "Press N to create a ticket from anywhere.",
    tipKey: "N",
    actionTitle: "New ticket",
    secondaryActionTitle: "Import",
    action: {},
    secondaryAction: {}
)

examples.title: Filters hide everything
examples.code:
MonarchEmptyState(
    "No results",
    message: "No tickets match the filters.",
    kind: .filtered,
    size: .sm,
    onClearFilters: { isFiltered = false }
)
